test_title: PYST 20: SSC CGL 2025 - General Knowledge (Held On: 18th_September_2025_Shift_2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements about the Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) 2023 is **correct?**

options.text: The KIYG 2023 were held in four cities of Maharashtra.
The games included 20 disciplines and no demo sport.
The event lasted for 13 days across 15 venues.

solution:
The correct answer is __**The event lasted for 13 days across 15 venues**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) 2023 lasted for **13 days** and were conducted from **January 30 to February 11, 2023**.
 
• The games were held across **15 venues** in different parts of Madhya Pradesh, including Bhopal, Indore, Gwalior, and Jabalpur.
 
• A total of **6,000 athletes** from all over India participated in KIYG 2023, competing across various disciplines.
 
• The event featured **27 sports disciplines**, including 4 demonstration sports: Mallakhamb, Yogasana, Gatka, and Kalaripayattu.
 
• KIYG 2023 was organized by the **Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports** under the Government of India to promote sports culture at the grassroots level.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: The KIYG 2023 were held in four cities of Maharashtra.**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect. KIYG 2023 was held in Madhya Pradesh, not Maharashtra. The host cities were Bhopal, Indore, Gwalior, and Jabalpur.
 
• Each city hosted different sports events to ensure even distribution of infrastructure and facilities.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: The games included 20 disciplines and no demo sport.**
 
 
• This statement is incorrect. KIYG 2023 featured **27 sports disciplines**, out of which **4 were demonstration sports**.
 
• The demonstration sports included traditional and indigenous games: Mallakhamb, Yogasana, Gatka, and Kalaripayattu, showcasing India's rich sporting heritage.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Only 4000 athletes participated in KIYG 2023.**
 
 
• This statement is incorrect. KIYG 2023 saw the participation of around **6,000 athletes** from across India, making it one of the largest grassroots sports events in the country.
 
• The athletes competed across a wide variety of sports, including athletics, swimming, badminton, and kabaddi.
 
 
 
• **Main Theme: Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG)**
 
 
• Khelo India Youth Games is a flagship initiative by the Ministry of Youth Affairs and Sports aimed at **identifying and nurturing young sporting talent**.
 
• The program provides financial assistance, infrastructure, and training support to encourage grassroots participation in sports.
 
• It helps promote a culture of sports and fitness in the country in line with the vision of a healthier and more active India.
